description: The StopButton_DI block is used for signal processing of a digital input value, specifically in the context of S7-300/400 SM digital input modules.

inputs.name: VALUE
inputs.description: The digital input value from the process image.

inputs.name: VALUE_QC
inputs.description: The value status of the digital input channel, used when PQC is TRUE.

inputs.name: MODE
inputs.description: Influences how the block treats the digital value, with the high byte determining value status.

inputs.name: PQC
inputs.description: Determines if the block reads the value status of the digital value from the process image.

inputs.name: SIM_I
inputs.description: The simulation value output when SIM_ON is TRUE.

inputs.name: SUBS_I
inputs.description: The substitute value used when the digital input is invalid and SUBS_ON is TRUE.

inputs.name: SUBS_ON
inputs.description: Enables substitution of the digital input value when it is invalid.

inputs.name: LAST_ON
inputs.description: Determines if the last valid output value should be held when the input becomes invalid.

outputs.name: QBAD
outputs.description: Indicates if the process value is invalid.

outputs.name: QLAST
outputs.description: Indicates if the last valid value injection is active.

outputs.name: QUALITY
outputs.description: The quality code of the output value.
